# Setup Checklist: Project Setup

**Purpose**: Requirements quality for startup, error format and contract publication
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Startup Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Is "one command per side" defined precisely enough to tell which prerequisite steps (dependency install, client generation) count inside or outside the command? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the prerequisites that must already exist on the developer machine listed completely? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for the order of starting backend and frontend, or is order-independence stated? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the behavior on restart specified for existing data, including a database whose migrations are partly applied? [Coverage, Spec §US1 Scenario 3, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the port-in-use edge case quantified with what the developer must see, not only "a clear message"? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the 10-minute start target scoped with the conditions it assumes (connection, cold caches)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Are rollback or recovery requirements defined for a failed migration at startup? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the database-unwritable and database-missing cases both reflected in functional requirements, not only edge cases? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-004]

## Health Check Requirements

- [ ] CHK009 Is the meaning of overall status versus database status defined when they disagree? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "proven by a read and a write" specified as to what is persisted and whether it must leave data behind? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK011 Is a time bound defined for the health check itself to answer before it is considered DOWN? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the frontend's reaction to a degraded (DOWN database) answer distinguished from an unreachable backend? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the 2-second visibility target tied to a defined measurement point? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

## Error Format Requirements

- [ ] CHK014 Are the fields of the common error format enumerated and their meaning stated in the spec? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "no internal details" defined with concrete examples of what must never appear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK016 Are all failure classes (unknown address, malformed input, unsupported method, unexpected failure) covered by requirements? [Coverage, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the 100% target for the common format scoped to all responses, including those produced outside the application code? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements consistent between the error format in the spec and the constitution's problem+json principle? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it specified how the frontend must present an error from this format? [Gap]

## Contract Publication Requirements

- [ ] CHK020 Is "single document" defined with where it lives and who may change it and when? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements stated for keeping the generated client in sync with the contract (when and how it is regenerated)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §US4]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the scope of "verified against the contract" defined: every response, every status code, request shapes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the expected outcome when a response deviates from the contract stated as a failing check? [Measurability, Spec §US4]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for how later features extend the contract without breaking the foundation? [Gap, Dependency]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Is the assumption that no business behavior exists consistent with the presence of a seed mechanism and a time source? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-012, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the requirement and acceptance-criteria ID scheme sufficient to trace each success criterion to requirements? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
